theme.description: Premium, trustworthy, and organic yet highly functional. Using the brand's Deep Teal-Green to evoke cleanliness and eco-friendliness, while the Warm Off-White provides a soft, unclinical background. The aesthetic borrows from Apple's modern UI with purposeful data density.

rules: Use tracking-tight for all headings above 32px.
Overlines/Labels MUST be Uppercase + Tiny + Wide Spacing (tracking-[0.2em]).
Line height: leading-none for headers, leading-relaxed for body.
Never use pure black for text, use the defined text_primary (#06291F).

layout_and_spacing.sidebar: w-[220px] fixed h-screen border-r border-[#E2E0D8] bg-[#F4F3EF] z-40
layout_and_spacing.density: High density, functional beauty. Use the 'Control Room' grid pattern for the Admin Dashboard.
layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Tailwind scale. Use p-6 or p-8 for containers with borders.
layout_and_spacing.grid_admin: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 with gap-4 or gap-6. Every pixel utilized. h-full on children.
layout_and_spacing.mobile_layout: Responsive mobile-first grids. Use generous padding (p-6) for client app. Max image height 80vh.

components.badges: Status badges MUST include a glowing colored indicator dot. e.g.,
components.cards: Cardless or dense styles for admin. Use surface (#FFFFFF) with 1px border (#E2E0D8). Subtle shadow only on hover. Max border radius 8px.
components.tables: Virtualized tables for high density data. Stick to 10-15 rows default view with explicit filters. Use slide-over detail panels instead of expanding rows.
components.inputs: Shadcn components heavily customized to match the brand. Use #0C5E48 for focus rings.

motion.hover: Explicit text color on hover. Slight lift (-translate-y-1) for dashboard cards.
motion.mobile: Smooth micro-interactions for OTP entry and order stage animations.

media.icons: lucide-react for standard elements. Use @phosphor-icons/react if more dense line-icons are needed.

testing.attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case, role-based.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build WashFlow: an enterprise laundry ERP with 3 roles: Admin (Web), Client (Mobile Web), Delivery (Mobile Web).
Enforce strict 220px fixed sidebar for Admin. Use the brand color #0C5E48 as primary.
Use Geist for Admin and Cabinet Grotesk + Plus Jakarta Sans for Mobile Apps.
Apply purposeful density for Admin: No generic empty card grids. Use 'Control Room' grid structure, dense tables, compact indicators.
Status indicators must use glowing dots using box-shadow.
All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes for testing.
Include the provided SVG logo in the header.
Use Apple-style modern UI: crisp borders (#E2E0D8), surface (#FFFFFF) and background (#F4F3EF), soft radii (max 8px), high contrast text.
